Check a donation address

Every donation address here is one of the CCS wallet’s subaddresses, from a list made offline and signed. Check it with a key that doesn’t come from this site: whoever took over the site could change the addresses, the list, its signature and this page together.

  1. Get the key from the design repository, github.com/plowsof/ccs-front-hugo (in keys/, its fingerprint in the README). Type the address yourself rather than following a link from here, or ask someone you trust for the fingerprint.

  2. Download the list and its signature, and check them with that key:

    gpg --import <the key from step 1>
gpg --verify subaddresses.txt.asc subaddresses.txt

  3. Look for the address your wallet shows after scanning or pasting (a QR code can hold another address than the text beside it):

    grep -c " THE_ADDRESS$" subaddresses.txt

    1: it is the wallet’s. 0: do not send, tell the CCS maintainers.

This site says the fingerprint is 0123 4567 89AB CDEF 0123 4567 89AB CDEF 0123 4567: if it differs from the one you got, do not send.

Or ask the wallet itself

The wallet’s address and view key are public (where they were published): take them from there, found yourself, not from this page. A copy of the wallet made from them, offline, says whether an address is its own; a view key can’t spend. This site says they are:

The wallet’s address: 9xExampleWalletAddress

Its view key: 0123456789abcdef

With monero-wallet-rpc from the Monero CLI (getmonero.org, hashes checked), in one terminal:

monero-wallet-rpc --testnet --offline --wallet-dir ccs-check --rpc-bind-port 18088 --disable-rpc-login

and in another:

rpc() { curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18088/json_rpc -d "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":0,\"method\":\"$1\",\"params\":$2}"; }
rpc generate_from_keys '{"filename":"ccs","address":"9xExampleWalletAddress","viewkey":"0123456789abcdef","password":""}'
rpc set_subaddress_lookahead '{"password":"","major_idx":1,"minor_idx":20000}'
rpc get_address_index '{"address":"THE_ADDRESS"}'

"index":{"major":0,"minor":…}: it is the wallet’s. Address doesn't belong to the wallet: do not send, tell the CCS maintainers. Delete ccs-check when done.
